description: A six-step mandatory onboarding with funnel data showing a 54% drop at the calendar-connect step and interview notes citing IT-blocked OAuth and solo trials; a correct answer makes calendar connect and invites deferrable, adds progress indication, and grounds each change in the data.

ui-ux-designer.task: Redesign the onboarding flow in `{fixture}/flow.md` using `{fixture}/funnel.md` and `{fixture}/research-notes.md`. You cannot write files in this run, so put your complete proposed flow and rationale in your final message.

rubricPoints.requirement: Makes calendar connection (step 3) skippable or deferred, citing the drop from 7,900 to 3,600 users and/or the IT-blocked OAuth interviews.
Cites the activation data (61% for users who skipped step 3 and connected later vs 64% for finishers) as evidence that deferring the calendar does not hurt activation much.
Makes inviting teammates (step 4) optional, citing solo users trying the product alone and/or the drop from 3,600 to 2,300.
Adds a visible progress indicator showing the current step and how many steps remain.
